entries: The {rival} was paying {the_someone:human} all along, and {the_thing} was the receipt.
{the_someone:human} did the job, and {first} took the pay.
{the_disaster:manmade} covered a debt, and {the_someone:human} signed for it.
There was no one to catch: {the_someone:human} walked free {MANNER}, as the city intended.
{the_thing:!living} was bait, and the {rival} owned the trap.
{first} had worked for the {rival} from the start, and never knew.
The {rival} wanted {first} to find {the_thing} {HIDING}, and so {first} did.
Whoever {first} named, the {rival} would still own {landmark:built} by morning.
{the_someone:human} took the fall {MANNER}, out of {MOTIVE}, and the {rival} sent flowers.
It was never about {the_disaster:manmade}; it was about {MOTIVE}, and who paid for it.
